'''Bottom:''' Chicken tinola with green [[papaya]] and [[lemongrass]] | alternate_name = | country = [[Philippines|The Philippines]] | region = | creator = | course = [[Main course]] | served = Hot | main_ingredient = [[Chicken (food)|Chicken]], green papaya, [[siling labuyo]] leaves, ginger, onion, fish sauce | variations = {{bulleted list|Pork with chayote and moringa | Fish with tomatoes | ''[[Linarang|Nilarang/Linarang]]'' {{small|(Cebuano variant)}} }} | calories = | similar_dish = ''[[tiyula itum|Tiyula itum]]'', ''[[bulalo]]'' | other = }} '''Tinola''' is a [[Filipino cuisine|Filipino]] [[soup]] usually served as a [[main course]] with white rice.{{cite web | title=Tinola: A Favorite Philippine Cuisine | publisher=Philippines Insider| url=http://www.philippinesinsider.com/filipino-cuisine/recipes/tinola-a-favorite-philippine-cuisine/ | access-date=June 5, 2010}} Traditionally, the dish is cooked with chicken or fish, wedges of [[papaya]] and/or [[chayote]], and leaves of the [[siling labuyo]] [[chili pepper]] in broth flavored with [[ginger]], [[onion]]s, and [[fish sauce]].
